name: rakuten_item_search
description: ANSWERS "what does <item> cost on Rakuten Japan" / "cheapest <product> on Rakuten Ichiba", searches items on Japan's Rakuten Ichiba marketplace by keyword (Japanese or English) and returns name, price in JPY, shop, review score and item link. Data: Rakuten Group, Rakuten Ichiba item data. Requires your own free Rakuten Web Service key: pass `_apiKey` as "applicationId:accessKey"; without it the tool says it requires an API key. Returns up to 30 items per page.

keyword.description: Search words, e.g. "ワイン" or "sake set"
